title: spec(data): a shared NULL-distinct unique conformance case-set, scored by the driver census

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBY61hHdLdFdzwXbxaNtv58y)_
Fixes #29377
Supersedes #29509 (same commits, resumed on a new branch)
Ruling-ref: 6595804527

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`@objectstack/spec/data` 新增一套共享的一致性用例 `UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT_CASES`（10 条）：唯一键任一列为空（`null` 或没写）的两条记录都能保存；`''` 和相同的非空值照旧冲突；单列 `unique` 与两列联合唯一索引各有覆盖。驱动一致性普查把它登记为新的一列，6 个驱动各记一条 DEBT 待接入。
- **为什么改**：MongoDB 驱动曾把第二条空值记录拒掉（#29278，已由 #29339 修好），期间普查全绿，因为没有任何用例问这个问题。有了这套用例，下一个驱动或回归再把空值合并成同一个键，就会在普查里被记为未覆盖、在驱动接入后直接变红。
- **风险与回滚**：只新增测试支撑导出，不改任何驱动、schema 或运行时行为。回滚 = revert 本 PR。新增 4 个公开名（见下文 New public names）；普查账本多出 6 条 DEBT，已按裁决 6595804527（A，维护者「同意」）原样保留。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/data/unique-null-distinct-conformance.ts`（用例与实测出处）；`scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs` 新增的 6 条 DEBT；`unique-null-distinct-conformance.test.ts` 的六种错误读法。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs`，预期矩阵多出 `UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT` 一列、6 格 `DEBT`，结尾 `OK — 66 covered cell(s), 6 in the DEBT ledger`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## Resume note

This PR carries #29509's five commits unchanged (head `0c0e86d0`, contract review PASS, record 6583589505 on #29509), resumed on this branch because a card thread can push only its own branch. On top: one merge of `origin/main` @ `25450217` (no conflict; main had not moved `scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs` since the old merge base, so the census and the six DEBT rows are byte-identical to #29509), and one regeneration commit for `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json` and `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json` (both moved on main; `os-regen-merge.sh` took main's side and `check:generated --fix` re-added exactly this PR's four names). The case-set, its test, the changeset and the census are unchanged from `0c0e86d0`.

## What changes

- **New case-set** `packages/spec/src/data/unique-null-distinct-conformance.ts`, beside `value-roundtrip-conformance.ts` and `readable-ids-conformance.ts`, in their shape. Ten cases over two fixture objects: `unique_null_single` (field-level `unique: 'global'` on `code`) and `unique_null_compound` (declared index `{ fields: ['region', 'tag'], unique: 'global' }`).

  | case | rows | second write |
  |---|---|---|
  | `single_null_null` | `code: null` twice | admitted |
  | `single_absent_absent` | `code` omitted twice | admitted |
  | `single_null_absent` | `null`, then omitted | admitted |
  | `single_equal_value` | the same string twice | refused |
  | `single_empty_string` | `''` twice | refused |
  | `compound_one_null` | `(r1, null)` twice | admitted |
  | `compound_leading_null` | `(null, t2)` twice | admitted |
  | `compound_one_absent` | `(r3, omitted)` twice | admitted |
  | `compound_equal` | `(r4, t4)` twice | refused |
  | `compound_differs_in_one_part` | `(r5, t5a)`, `(r5, t5b)` | admitted |

  The consumption recipe is in the module docblock: sync both objects, `create()` the first row (must be admitted), `create()` the second and record `refused` only when `isUniqueViolationError` (`@objectstack/types`) recognises the error, count the rows labelled with the case, and hand both to `uniqueNullDistinctDivergence`. The count is there because a driver can refuse a write and keep it. Every non-NULL key value belongs to one case, so a suite may run all ten on one synced pair of objects (pinned).
- **Scope spelled `'global'` on both surfaces.** The scope of `unique` (ADR-0120 D1, ADR-0131 D1) is a different axis and stays out of this table; `'global'` is the one spelling that means the same key on every driver with or without a tenant column. A bare `true` on a declared index is refused since protocol 18, and the test parses both fixture objects through `ObjectSchema`.
- **`packages/spec/src/data/index.ts`**: the `export *` line with its comment.
- **Census registration** in `scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs`: a `CASE_SETS` row (`file`, `marker: 'UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT_CASES'`, `what`), and one `LEDGER` row per driver (`kind: 'DEBT'`, `issue: '#29377'`), each with its measured state in `why`. A history note above `LEDGER` records why the column opens with six rows (the FILTER_TEXT shape: the contract lands ahead of its suites) and how a row clears (the driver's PR adds the suite and deletes its row; RECONCILED reds a row kept beside a suite). No driver package is touched.
- Regenerated: `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/data.json` (four added names each).
- Changeset `.changeset/29377-unique-null-distinct-conformance.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch.

## New public names

Under `@objectstack/spec` (the `data` entry), spelled like the sibling case-sets:

### `UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT_CASES`
The cases constant and the census marker (the census discovers `export const ..._CASES`).

### `UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT_OBJECTS`
The two fixture objects, as `syncSchema` takes them (cf. `VALUE_ROUNDTRIP_FIELDS`, `READABLE_IDS_PARENT_OBJECT`).

### `UniqueNullDistinctCase`
The row type (cf. `ValueRoundTripCase`, `ReadableIdsCase`).

### `uniqueNullDistinctDivergence`
The shared judge, `(case, second, stored) => string | null` (cf. `valueRoundTripDivergence`). A pure comparison over two observed values, no runtime logic.

## Why

PR #29339 (#29278) made driver-mongodb admit a second `null` in a unique field. Its old sparse index indexed an explicit `null` like a value. driver-sql and driver-memory already admitted it, and the census stayed green through the whole divergence because no case-set asked the question. `value-roundtrip-conformance.ts` describes the same gap for value storage: no case-set, no evidence.

## Tests

No existing test was edited. One new file, `packages/spec/src/data/unique-null-distinct-conformance.test.ts` (23 tests):

- **The table, executed** against a reference store written from the declared rule (a NULL in any key part exempts the row; `''` is a value): each case alone, and all ten in order on one store.
- **Not vacuous**: six wrong readings each fail the table. They are a sparse index (null indexed), null and absent folded onto one value, `''` treated as NULL (fails exactly `single_empty_string`), a compound keyed on its first column, a constraint never checked, and a refusal that keeps the row (both fail exactly the three refused rows).
- **The judge**: `null` only on the expected answer and the expected count.
- **Well-formed**: unique names, rows labelled, non-NULL key values owned by one case, both answers on both objects, both objects accepted by `ObjectSchema`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The compound row was measured before it was written. The three drivers agree.** `driver-memory` and `driver-sql` (better-sqlite3) were run in-process over all ten cases on `origin/main` @ `f95d0dba`, judged by `uniqueNullDistinctDivergence` and `isUniqueViolationError`: 10 of 10 agree on each (readings below). `driver-mongodb` was **not run against a server here**: no mongod binary was reachable in this container (`fastdl.mongodb.org` is blocked, and fetching the conda-forge build was refused). Its standing readings are PR #29339's real-mongod suite (mongod 8.3.7), which covers six of the ten rows: `single_null_null`, `single_absent_absent`, `single_equal_value`, `single_empty_string`, `compound_one_null`, `compound_equal`. The other four follow from the index shape that suite's server-free half pins (a `partialFilterExpression` admitting only non-NULL types on every key part). Its server-free half ran here: `mongodb-unique-null-distinct.test.ts` 7 passed, 8 skipped (real-mongod, opt-in). The driver's adoption PR is the measurement for those four.
- **The update door is out of the table.** Clearing a unique field to `null` by `update()` was measured on driver-mongodb in #29339 only, so it is named as absent in the docblock rather than added without a measurement.
- **driver-odata** gets a DEBT row like the others, but its `syncSchema` is a no-op (the remote service owns constraints). Its adoption card decides whether that cell is a suite or an EXEMPT row.
- The census's own CONSUMED message marks a ledger entry `⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY`. These six rows are what the card asks for (a case-set landing ahead of its drivers), so the maintainer's review of this PR is that agreement.

## Verification

memory   compound_leading_null          second=admitted stored=2 agrees

memory   compound_equal                 second=refused  stored=1 agrees  UNIQUE_VIOLATION

Every first write was admitted on both drivers.
</details>
